name: absolute_state_five_column_output_transfer
provenance: OURS+PUBLIC; fixed feature vocabulary adapted from T132/T133 venture_agent_ai public calibration; existing ALG031 closure and head retained

candidate.head: Add Z @ absolute_delta to existing ALG031 raw correction, inside its existing +/-0.25*cap and nonnegative final output. Earlier output rows unchanged.
candidate.fit: One standardized active-Jacobian ridge step anchored at zero new coefficients; existing coefficients frozen. RMS normalize columns, J=Z/s*I(abs(raw)<limit and parent>0); lambda_j=.01*diag(J.T J); solve (J.T J+diag(lambda)) beta=J.T(target-parent). Penalize all five columns including intercept. Try ordered backtrack steps, accept first penalized improvement; zero/no descent stops.
candidate.native_state: Terminal closure state only; row_mass=(sum(abs(cov_pre),axis=1)-abs(var_pre))/1024. var_pre floored1e-12, matching public feature spelling. Scale mean by physical_scale and variance/row_mass by physical_scale squared. Float32 row reduction, then float64 five-column head.

comparison.optional_extension_selection: Reuse the already predetermined T124 extension rows; no outcome-based row selection
comparison.extension_condition: one extension only if likely to change decision; disclose repeat look
comparison.scoring: arithmetic mean terminal MSE times max(.1, actual FLOPs/2**41), each algorithm charged independently
